lede: Devolution and County/Local Government Management provides a structured approach to transferring authority and resources while strengthening accountability, efficiency, and service delivery. The course develops practical skills in implementation planning, resource allocation, stakeholder engagement, performance monitoring, fiscal transparency, and governance audits. You will build a devolution implementation plan, conduct a mock local governance audit, and create tools for reporting, crisis management, and multi-year development planning. The programme also introduces decentralization models and comparative case studies, helping leaders turn governance findings into actionable executive decisions.

prerequisites: Prerequisites: This advanced course requires participants to have at least 5 years of experience in public administration, local government management, or policy development. A working knowledge of public finance principles, constitutional law regarding devolution, and stakeholder engagement strategies is essential. No coding or programming skills are required. Participants should bring a laptop for hands-on exercises involving data visualization and dashboard creation. Advanced concepts are taught at an operational application level (how to commission and consume frameworks) and hands-on implementation level (building plans and conducting audits), not just conceptual awareness.
